R. 3095 _______________________________________________________________________ AN ACT To direct the United States Postal Service to designate single, unique ZIP Codes for certain communities, and for other purposes. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled, SECTION 1. SINGLE, UNIQUE ZIP CODES FOR CERTAIN COMMUNITIES. Not later than 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the United States Postal Service shall designate a single, unique ZIP Code for each of the following communities: (1) Canyon Lake, California.
